skill.acrobatics.gist: Stay on your feet in a tricky spot, or pull off an acrobatic stunt

skill.animal-handling.gist: Calm or train an animal, or get it to behave a certain way

skill.arcana.gist: Recall lore about spells, magic items and the planes of existence

skill.athletics.gist: Jump farther, stay afloat in rough water, or break something

skill.deception.gist: Tell a convincing lie, or wear a disguise convincingly

skill.history.gist: Recall lore about past events, people, nations and cultures

skill.insight.gist: Read a person's mood and intentions

skill.intimidation.gist: Awe or threaten someone into doing what you want

skill.investigation.gist: Find obscure facts in books, or work out how something works

skill.medicine.gist: Diagnose an illness, or tell what killed the recently slain

skill.nature.gist: Recall lore about terrain, plants, animals and weather

skill.perception.gist: Notice something easy to miss, using all your senses

skill.performance.gist: Act, tell a story, play music or dance

skill.religion.gist: Recall lore about gods, rituals and holy symbols

skill.sleight-of-hand.gist: Pick a pocket, hide a small object, or do a trick of the hand

skill.stealth.gist: Move quietly and hide to escape notice

skill.survival.gist: Follow tracks, forage, find a trail or avoid natural hazards
